# Dialog

A centred modal for a decision that must be made before anything else continues. A panel of settings belongs in a `Sheet`.

## Anatomy

A scrim, then a square-cornered panel: header with optional eyebrow and title, body, and an optional footer of actions.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `boolean` | `$bindable(false)` | — |
| `title` *(required)* | `string` | — | — |
| `eyebrow` | `string` | `''` | — |
| `modalOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | A destructive confirmation must be dismissed deliberately, so the scrim and Escape stop closing it. |
| `onclose` | `() => void` | — | — |
| `children` *(required)* | `Snippet` | — | — |
| `footer` | `Snippet` | — | — |

## Variants

`modalOnly` for a destructive confirmation, which the scrim and `Escape` stop dismissing.

## States

Open, closed.

## Keyboard

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab`, `Shift+Tab` | Cycle within the dialog; focus cannot leave it. |
| `Escape` | Closes it, unless `modalOnly`. |

## ARIA

`role="dialog"` with `aria-modal` and `aria-labelledby` pointing at the title. Focus moves in on open and returns to the opener on close, both through the carried-over `focusTrap` action; `dismissable` keeps `Escape` and outside clicks reaching only the topmost layer.

## Accessibility acceptance criteria

- Reachable, operable and leavable by keyboard alone, with a focus indicator meeting 3:1 in both schemes.
- An accessible name for every control, and current state exposed programmatically.
- No meaning carried by colour alone.
- Legible and operable at a 360px viewport and at desktop width, and at 200% zoom.
- Interactive targets at least 44 × 44px on touch-capable viewports.

## Reference correspondence

None. The reference's only dialog is its settings sheet, which it also uses for confirmations. A centred dialog is drawn in the same idiom — square corners, a hairline boundary, the same header rhythm as `Sheet`.

None.
